beats.care: Expect higher cab and CNG costs, pricier food, and maybe no cut in your loan EMIs soon.
beats.what: Brent crude hit $117.42 a barrel on Friday. India's crude basket averaged about $120 in October, far above the RBI's $95 assumption.
beats.why: The RBI Bulletin says rice, wheat, pulses and edible oil prices are rising. Wholesale inflation hit 11.4% in September, the first double digit in the new series.
